title: L2ContractMigrationFacet zeroes global per-token silo balances on every redeem
description: addMigratedDepositsToAccount declares local uint128 totalDeposited and totalDepositedBdv (lines 159-160) but never increments them inside the deposit loop. After crediting per-account deposits, lines 194-195 assign these still-zero locals to the protocol-wide totals s.sys.silo.balances[token].deposited and .depositedBdv. The redeem entry point (redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances) is permissionless (anyone with a valid proof+signature can call it), so the global silo balance for every migrated token is overwritten to 0 on each call, while per-account deposit records (s.accts[account].deposits[depositId]) are written correctly and remain non-zero. This is a hard assignment (=), not an increment, so it also clobbers whatever ReseedSilo previously set. Independently verified against source: locals are declared and never written before being stored to global state.
impact: Global deposited/depositedBdv for every token routed through contract migration is set to 0 while per-account deposits exist, breaking the core invariant total == sum(accounts) (ACC-002). Downstream consumers that read s.sys.silo.balances[token] for BDV ratios, convert valuation, gauge weighting and withdrawal accounting are corrupted protocol-wide: a depositor whose token total reads 0 cannot have their withdrawal decrement reconciled (DoS / underflow), and BDV/convert math that scales by global deposited can be skewed to mint unbacked BDV/stalk. Permissionless, deterministic, protocol-wide accounting corruption with no rescue path short of a governance upgrade.

ite.intent: Corrupt protocol-wide silo balances to 0 while per-account deposits persist, desyncing all withdraw/convert/BDV math
ite.technique: Locals totalDeposited/totalDepositedBdv never incremented (L2ContractMigrationFacet.sol:159-160) then assigned to s.sys.silo.balances[token] (lines 194-195) via the permissionless redeem path
ite.evasion: fundsSafu/noSupplyChange/nonReentrant guard reentrancy and net supply, not internal accounting consistency; no invariant reconciles global total to the sum of accounts

ice_chain.consumer_function: LibTokenSilo / SiloFacet.withdrawDeposit decrements global deposited; LibConvert and BDV getters scale by global depositedBdv
ice_chain.consumer_action: decrements/scales against a zeroed global total -> withdrawal underflow (DoS) or mispriced BDV/convert (unbacked value)
